## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

List the commands or scenarios used to verify the change.

## Operational and security impact

Note changes to manifests, migrations, service behavior, process execution, paths, secrets, routing, or privileges. Write `None` when not applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated generated files.
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior.
- [ ] Backend formatting, build, and tests pass.
- [ ] Frontend lint, tests, and build pass when applicable.
- [ ] Documentation and example configuration are updated when needed.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, environment values, or private paths are included.
- [ ] User input cannot become an arbitrary command, executable, hostname, or filesystem path.
- [ ] UI changes are keyboard accessible and include screenshots when useful.
